notes: The report is WHO AFRO Weekly External Situation Report 19 on Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a filovirus outbreak, not Zaire ebolavirus. It gives no issue date; it states only 'Data as of 20 September 2026', so report_date is null. It contains only aggregate figures and no individual case records with confirmation or onset dates, so new_cases is empty. The 7,733 confirmed cases and 3,732 deaths are cumulative totals as of 20 September 2026. The 3,687 validated suspected cases refer to the week of 14-20 September, not a cumulative suspected total, so suspected_cases is null. The 33,520 contacts are those under follow-up as of 20 September. Cumulative recoveries were 1,902 as of 20 September 2026, which is not a line-list outcome and is not in the totals schema. The report also states 47 health worker cases and 6 health worker infections in the latest week, but these are not individual records.
